# Forest Machining — guanhaoauto.com

> Forest Machining is a precision CNC machining company based in Dongguan, China. We provide CNC turning, CNC milling, 5-axis machining, and rapid prototyping services for prototypes and production parts, serving aerospace, automotive, and medical industries.

- [Contact](https://guanhaoauto.com/contact/): Request a quote or ask about your project.
